cls.quote: E-bike Classification | Class 2 | Max assist speed | 20 mph
The standard Borrego+ is a Class 2 ebike with a throttle and pedal assistance up to 20 mph.

range.quote: Claimed range ⟶ Up to 70 miles on the current product listing

wt.quote: The Borrego+ weighs approximately 87 pounds with its battery installed. Removing the battery saves about eight pounds, but the bike is still too heavy for many standard bike racks and may be difficult for one person to lift. ⟶ What is the range of the Trek Borrego+?

load.quote: This bike has a maximum total weight limit (combined weight of bicycle, rider, and cargo) of 440 pounds (199 kg).
Total weight limit ⟶ 440 pounds, including bike, rider, and cargo

motor.quote: E-bike Classification Class 2 ⟶ Motor Hyena hub drive, 750W
The Trek Borrego+ uses a Hyena rear-hub motor with up to 750W of output and 90Nm of torque. Those numbers matter on a bike this heavy, particularly when starting from a stop or carrying cargo.

height.quote: Rider height range ⟶ Approximately 5 feet 1 inch to 6 feet 6 inches, depending on size

fold.quote: Its alloy step-through frame makes the bike easier to mount than its size might suggest.
